### `flowda_template` · `POST /v1/template`

Scope `extract` · `/v1` budget 130s · gateway pre-charge 5 credit.

| field | type | required | notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| params | object | yes | Template input. The exact schema (including the identifier key) is `data.data.params_schema` from `GET /v1/templates/{template_id}`; it describes the whole request body (`template` plus `params`), and unknown keys are rejected. |
